page.content:
Vampire Queen, rock bass, and daughter of the Nightosphere.

How Marceline connects

  • Character: Hunson Abadeer — Hunson is Marceline's father.
  • Character: Simon Petrikov — Simon protected Marceline after the Mushroom War.
  • Location: Nightosphere — Marceline is a daughter of the Nightosphere.
  • Character: Princess Bubblegum — Marceline and Bubblegum share a long, repaired history.

What is Marceline?

Marceline the Vampire Queen is the thousand-year-old bass player who survived the Mushroom War as a child, feuds and reconciles with Bubblegum, and is Hunson's daughter.

Key threads lead to Hunson Abadeer, Simon Petrikov, Nightosphere and Princess Bubblegum.
